title: Sequencing: document routing
bodyMd:
Five documents are processed sequentially by one clerk. Each is processed once, with no simultaneous processing.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Form, Letter, Memo, Notice, Report.

- Exactly 2 other items must occur between Form and Report.
- Letter must precede Memo.
- Notice must not be in position 5.
